SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON:HONESTY
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on:Honesty helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON:HONESTY
Study Hadith on:Honesty like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

What this means
In this part you learn to Apply the teachings of problems. your friend’s pen in the Hadith in  Organize. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Apply the teachings of problems. your friend’s pen in the Hadith in  Organize.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Your turn

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on:Honesty is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on:Honesty” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Read the selected  Learners are guided through problems on issues 3. What would you do Hadith correctly. related to honesty and provide solutions to the when you collect)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on:Honesty in your own words. (skill: Apply the teachings of problems. your friend’s pen in the Hadith in  Organize)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on:Honesty to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Read the selected  Learners are guided through problems on issues 3. What would you do Hadith correctly. related to honesty and provide solutions to the when you collect.
3. Practise this skill: Apply the teachings of problems. your friend’s pen in the Hadith in  Organize.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on:Honesty from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on:Honesty: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Hadith on:Honesty?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is honesty?
2. When do you (3 lessons) be able to:  Learners listen to a story on the virtue of honesty practice honesty?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on:Honesty means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Read the selected  Learners are guided through problems on issues 3. What would you do Hadith correctly. related to honesty and provide solutions to the when you collect.
5. Be able to: Apply the teachings of problems. your friend’s pen in the Hadith in  Organize.
